summary: Stacked sections that expand in place. Lets users scan headings and open only what they need.

children: Semantic color tokens alias the palette roles of the active brand.

whenToUse: Long reference content where users look for one section: token groups, FAQ, advanced settings.
multiple when users compare sections; single (default) when sections are alternatives.
flush inside a card or a side panel, contained on a page.
whenNotToUse: Content everyone needs: do not hide it behind a click.
Switching between views of the same data: use Tabs.
Steps in a sequence: use a stepped layout with headings.

dos.title: Headings that work as a table of contents
dos.text: Users scan the closed state. Name each section by its content, and show a count in meta when it helps.

donts.title: Nesting accordions
donts.text: A collapsible inside a collapsible hides content twice. Flatten the structure or split the page.

accessibility: Base UI Accordion: each trigger is a button inside a heading (headingLevel, default h3) with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Panels are regions labelled by their trigger. Enter and Space toggle; Tab moves between triggers.
Disabled items stay visible but cannot open.
The height animation uses motion tokens and collapses to 0ms with reduced motion.
contentGuidelines: Titles are short nouns in sentence case, no ending punctuation.
Meta is a number or a one-word status, never a sentence.
